records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Owen,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: New signup alert -- *Orchard Dynamics* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone, and no reply to the welcome email [email:3e4758fd]. Zero tickets and zero inbound signals suggest low engagement; 8 days left on Starter. Some self-serve accounts do activate late, so not near-zero.

draft.subject: A hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Owen,

Following up on my note from last week. Since projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield and tasks live inside them, getting one project set up is usually the step that makes everything else click — and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through it with you and answer anything about how your team would organize work in Wrenfield.

Best,
Nadia
